noun_definition: web refers to the online platform or interface through which users interact with the Pay feature in Expensify.
Pay refers to the action of transferring money using the Expensify service within a chat interface.
Here page refers to the expected page that should open for adding a bank account when a user attempts to make a payment using Expensify.
gmail user refers to an individual using a Gmail account who is attempting to make a payment through the Expensify platform.
Expensify refers to a payment method used within the application that allows users to send money to others during a chat.
